operation_details.item: The user's email program uses a weekly send cadence.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Hey! How's your week starting? I saw you were in the office early - anything exciting on the marketing front?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Morning! Yeah, just reviewing our email performance. We keep a weekly send cadence, so I'm looking at what went out yesterday and planning this week's batch.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Is that for all your email programs, or just the main newsletter? I remember you manage a few different flows.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The weekly cadence applies to the main program, but we also have onboarding and re-engagement flows running on their own triggers. Those aren't strictly weekly - they're behavior-based.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Got it. And you're using Klaviyo for all of that, right? How's segmentation working for you?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yeah, Klaviyo handles everything. We segment by behavior, so it's pretty dynamic - people get different messages depending on what they've clicked or purchased.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds solid. So even though the main sends are weekly, the behavior segments keep things relevant between those sends.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. The weekly touchpoint keeps the brand top-of-mind, and the behavior segments make sure we're not just blasting the same thing to everyone.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only the weekly send cadence of my email program, while keeping the flows, tool, and segmentation.
